newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,540 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,540 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,540 contracts compared with 3,988 overnight Sunday.
There were 244 wheat, 765 corn, 435 soybean, five oat, two soyoil, 26 soymeal, 48 corn calls, 11 corn puts and four soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was four to five cents higher, corn was steady to 1-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were steady to 2-2/4 cents higher.
